name: Calendar
description: A civil-day selector. ISO dates are independent of the browser's timezone.

viewDate.description: Displayed month as YYYY-MM-DD, independently of selection.

defaultViewDate.description: Initial displayed month as YYYY-MM-DD; read only on initialization.

min.description: Earliest selectable civil date, inclusive, as YYYY-MM-DD.

max.description: Latest selectable civil date, inclusive, as YYYY-MM-DD.

disabledDates.description: Unavailable civil dates as YYYY-MM-DD strings.

disabled.description: Disable date selection and month navigation; remove internal controls from Tab.

readOnly.description: Prevent user selection while keeping focus and month navigation available.

locale.description: Date formatting language, numbering system and default first weekday; dates stay Gregorian.

labels.description: Internal navigation labels; use aria-label/aria-labelledby to name the calendar group.

weekStartsOn.description: Override the locale's first weekday: 0=Sunday through 6=Saturday.

aria-label.description: Accessible name of the calendar group; the inner grid is named by its displayed month.

aria-labelledby.description: External label IDs for the calendar group; takes precedence over aria-label.

aria-describedby.description: External description IDs for the calendar group.

selection.description: Select one day, or a range from a start day to an end day.

value.description: Selected day or range as YYYY-MM-DD; null clears the controlled value.

defaultValue.description: Initial uncontrolled day or range as YYYY-MM-DD.

excludeDisabledDates.description: Exclude unavailable days from the whole range; false constrains only its endpoints.

notes: Calendar navigation uses Button and Icon; title, weekdays and day labels route through Text/Button surfaces.
Cell sizing is derived from shared control geometry so calendar density follows enterprise control density.
